cancellation.v: 30-day free trial: cancel and receive a full refund excluding the one-time enrollment fee, AS LONG AS NO BENEFITS HAVE BEEN USED. After using the program, cancellation terminates benefits at the end of the billing cycle already billed. NCE authorization 'will remain in effect until NCE Association has received written notice from you that it should be cancelled at least 10 DAYS prior to your next bill date.' The FirstEnroll billing authorization in the same document requires written notice 'at least 15 DAYS prior to the next billing date'.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Selling a senior product to an under-65 book, or dismissing the label as a typo without checking.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not quote Health Choice Silver to an under-65 client on the assumption the 'Over 65' label is a portal error.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing. Do not present Health Choice Silver until the label is resolved.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: All eight Health Choice Silver variants carry the descriptor 'Over 65' on the FirstEnroll product list. Whether this is a portal mislabel or a genuine senior product is unresolved. Only one brochure exists for all eight variants and no certificate is held.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any use of this family.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Classifying any product from its name. Doing so produces errors in both directions - calling insurance a membership, and calling a service a discount.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Never type or describe a product from its name. Read the Info page.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Nothing client-facing. This is an internal rule.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: Product names in this portfolio are unreliable indicators of product type IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. 'AWA SimpleShield Membership Plan' is fixed indemnity insurance. 'Prime Health Pass Discount' is described on its own page as a Diagnostic Services Product delivering services. Between April and September NEO inserted the word 'Membership' into four Safe Guard product names without any evident change of type. Meanwhile 'AssistPro Discount' genuinely is a discount program.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Before any add-on is described on a call, and before any tooling assigns it a category.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Reassuring a caller that a condition is covered because it was never formally diagnosed. Under this wording a prescription written in the past twelve months is enough to trigger the exclusion. Also: telling a client chiropractic is covered because the membership lists Chiropractic Care - that is a discount, and the insurance specifically excludes musculoskeletal manipulation.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not say 'as long as you haven't been diagnosed'. Do not say chiropractic is covered. Do not imply the plan pays anything toward pregnancy.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: There is a twelve-month pre-existing condition limitation. If you have received any care from a doctor, or been prescribed anything, in the twelve months before your start date, claims related to that will not be covered for the first twelve months. Pregnancy is not covered. Work-related injuries are not covered.

source.sec: 679 chars, identical on all eight variants)

compliance_risks.verified_fact: 12-month pre-existing exclusion, defined by the disclosure as ANY care rendered OR PRESCRIBED by a physician in the 12 months before the effective date - not diagnosis, not treatment of a named condition. Pregnancy is excluded outright. Work-related injury or sickness is excluded whether or not workers' compensation pays. Chiropractic-type musculoskeletal manipulation is excluded from the insurance while a chiropractic DISCOUNT is bundled in the same membership.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Read from the disclosure wording, not from memory - the breadth of 'rendered or prescribed' is the whole point.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Quoting these plans to an under-65 caller as ordinary hospital indemnity, or to an over-65 caller without addressing Medicare. Both directions are unsupported.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a caller of any age that they are eligible or ineligible for Health Choice Silver. Do not describe it as a Medicare supplement, a Medicare companion, or a gap plan for Medicare - nothing in any source held supports any of those.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Do not position this product on age until the eligibility question is answered.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The storefront describes every variant of this family with the single phrase 'Over 65'. No source states any issue age.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: See C-016 and G-043. This one needs an answer from FirstEnroll before the family is sold at all.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Nothing directly - this is a defect in the document, not in what the agent says. But it means the clause telling the client who to contact about claims may be unreadable, and the client may later say they were never told who their agent was.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the agreement names their agent.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: Give the client your own name, agency and email verbally on the recorded call, and confirm you are their contact for benefit and claims questions. Do not rely on the agreement to have done it.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The FirstEnroll enrollment-agreement template served on the live storefront contains unrendered variables - $parentcompany, $product_label, $agent_fullname, $agent_Email, $parentemail - confirmed on two unrelated product families (American Financial Critical Illness page 38175, and Health Choice Silver page 32339). The affected clauses are the third-party administrator disclaimer, the Plan and Claims Inquiries clause and the Writing Agent Contact block.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: Raise with FirstEnroll whether the executed enrollment document renders these variables. See G-039.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Selling it to an under-65 caller, or selling it to a 65-plus caller without addressing what it does and does not do alongside Medicare. Prescription drugs, hearing aids and hearing exams, physical therapy, home health care and hospice are all excluded outright - which are precisely the exposures a Medicare-age caller asks about.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not present it to an under-65 caller. Do not describe it as a Medicare supplement, a Medigap plan or a Medicare Advantage alternative - nothing in any source supports any of those, and it is not one.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: This plan is designed for adults sixty-five and older. It pays fixed dollar amounts for specific services and it does not cover prescription drugs, hearing aids, physical therapy, home health care or hospice.

source.sec: held in Drive and linked from all eight storefront pages

compliance_risks.verified_fact: The brochure states under 'Who is Eligible?': 'Adults, 65 AND OLDER' and 'Dependent Children, age 1-25'. Health Choice Silver is a 65-and-older limited benefit health insurance plan underwritten by American Financial Security Life Insurance Co, sold through National Congress of Employers membership.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: This closes G-043 and resolves C-016. It also means eight live variants sit outside CHA's stated non-ACA under-65 book - a business question for management, not an agent question.

compliance_risks.could_misstate: Either half. A client sent the brochure sees 'no pre-existing condition limitations' on the GapAfford page and no pre-existing exclusion in the policy list. An agent reading the portal sees the 12-month exclusion but no 30-day waiting period. Neither document alone is sufficient and no single source contains both.
compliance_risks.do_not_say: Do not tell a client the brochure sets out the limitations. Do not repeat the GapAfford 'no pre-existing condition limitations' line without saying it applies to the discount programme and not to the insurance.
compliance_risks.safe_wording: There is a thirty-day waiting period before sickness benefits begin - injuries are covered from day one. And there is a twelve-month pre-existing condition limitation: if a doctor advised, treated or prescribed anything for a condition in the twelve months before your start date, claims for it are not covered for your first twelve months.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: The brochure carries a 30-day waiting period ('There is a 30 day waiting period immediately following the Coverage Effective Date; does not apply to an injury') that appears on neither the Info tab nor the 12,679-character enrollment agreement. Separately, the brochure's exclusion list contains NO pre-existing exclusion, while the enrollment agreement carries a 12-month one with a lookback covering any care rendered or prescribed by a physician.
compliance_risks.verify_before_saying: See C-032. Both facts should be stated on every recorded call until the brochure is corrected.

compliance_risks.do_not_say: For any product in this group, do not answer a coverage, exclusion, waiting-period or pre-existing question on a recorded call from portal material alone. Obtain the carrier document first.
compliance_risks.verified_fact: 51 of the 80 products on the NEO agent storefront have no brochure, certificate or policy document attached anywhere in the enrolment system. For those products the NEO reference page is the only available source, and four of those pages carry a limitations or exclusions heading with no text beneath it.

addons.gapafford_plus.v: GapAfford Plus - NCE Membership Benefits. Disclaimer printed on the same page: 'The benefits described on this page, GapAfford Plus, are NOT INSURANCE and are not affiliated with American Financial Security Life Insurance Co. The GapAfford Plus program does not meet the requirements of the PPACA. YOU MUST PAY FOR SERVICES AT THE TIME THEY ARE RENDERED. If you use a participating dentist, you will receive a discount. NEITHER GAPAFFORD PLUS, AETNA, NBBI, NOR THE DMPO WILL PAY FOR ANY SERVICES RECEIVED. The GapAfford Plus program is not available in Alaska, Connecticut, Delaware, Montana, Rhode Island, Utah, Vermont and Washington.' Components: prescription discount card (average 15% brand, 55% generic, national network, no usage limit, no activation, all FDA-approved drugs including lifestyle drugs); Aetna Dental Access Network (over 132,000 locations, 15-50% per visit, cosmetic dentistry and orthodontia included); OUTLOOK Vision Network (over 10,000 locations, 10-50% on eyeglasses frames and lenses, 10-30% on medical eye exams and PRK/LASIK); Pet Rx; Alternative Medicine (average 25% at over 8,000 providers including acupuncture and massage); Chiropractic Care (free initial consultation, up to 50% on diagnostics and x-rays, unlimited treatments at 30% savings, over 12,000 chiropractors); Hearing Savings (20-50% off MSRP); Imaging Savings (average 60% off MRI and CT); Medical Bill Negotiations (no minimum bill); Medical Supplies and Equipment (20-50%); Laboratory Savings via MyMedLab (NOT AVAILABLE IN NY, NJ OR RI); Physical Therapy (average 20% at over 1,200 offices in 23 states); Vitamins and Supplements (up to 75% off retail); 24/7 Health Information Line; 24/7 Nurse Help Line.
